name: sdg_08_10
alternateName: Real GDP per capita (chain-linked volumes, reference year 2020)
description: Real Gross Domestic Product per capita, expressed as chain-linked volumes in Euro per inhabitant with reference year 2020 (unit code CLV20_EUR_HAB). The experiment uses the principal aggregate B1GQ (GDP at market prices).

creator.name: Eurostat
creator.description: Statistical office of the European Union

publisher.name: Eurostat
publisher.description: Statistical office of the European Union

citeAs: Eurostat (2026). Real GDP per capita (chain-linked volumes, reference year 2020). Dataset sdg_08_10. https://doi.org/10.2908/SDG_08_10

distribution.name: 20260505_raw_sdg_08_10.csv
distribution.description: Snapshot of Eurostat dataset sdg_08_10 retrieved on 2026-05-05 and stored alongside the experiment for reproducibility.

recordSet.name: sdg_08_10
recordSet.description: One row per combination of the categorical dimensions; each year column (2014-2022) carries the measurement for that year in wide format. Year columns outside the 2014-2022 analysis window are present in the raw CSV but not enumerated here.

field.name: freq
field.description: Eurostat observation frequency code. Always 'A' (annual) in these extracts.

field.name: unit
field.description: Eurostat unit-of-measurement code (e.g. MIO_EUR, NR, CLV20_EUR_HAB). Numeric values in this CSV are in the unit indicated by this column.

field.name: geo
field.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (plus Eurostat aggregates such as EU27_2020). The original CSV header is 'geo\\TIME_PERIOD'.

field.name: na_item
field.description: National-accounts indicator code. The analysis selects B1GQ = Gross Domestic Product at market prices.
